meta.tagline: Personal stock-research app. Discovery (FMP fundamentals + X social signal + insider modifier) feeds a 6-phase LangGraph due-diligence pipeline with citations on every data point. Post-thesis surfaces (Today briefing, status board, unified calendar, material events, workspace loop, financial model, peer comp, outcome tracker, trade journal) close the feedback loop.

subsystems.name: Discovery Engine
subsystems.purpose: Per-theme ranked company cards merging FMP fundamentals with cached X social signals
scheduled_jobs: Daily X signal refresh at 2 AM (services/signal_scheduler.py)
subsystems.scoring: 40% X velocity + 40% fundamental quality + 20% discovery score when X is fresh; degrades to 80% fund + 20% disc when X is stale/missing
subsystems.perf_notes: surprise-alert lookup batched via one SurpriseAlert.ticker.in_(all_tickers) query (PR #43)

subsystems.name: 6-phase LangGraph due-diligence pipeline
subsystems.purpose: Per-ticker journey: quick_screen → deep_dive (9 categories) → targeted_followup → thesis_construction → risk_stress_test (optional loop) → position_monitor
subsystems.frontend_route: /pipeline/[runId] (handles both live SSE and completed report)
subsystems.routing_single_source: PHASE_SEQUENCE / next_phase() in graph/pipeline.py — services/pipeline.py::_next_phase delegates; pinned by backend/tests/test_phase_routing.py (PR #42)
subsystems.sse: multi-subscriber fan-out (dict[run_id, list[asyncio.Queue]]), no replay buffer
subsystems.formatters_module: backend/app/graph/formatters.py — _fmt_fundamentals (12 per-section helpers, PR #46), _build_curated_financials, _build_technical_data; re-exported from nodes.py (C2 split, PR #45)

subsystems.name: SEC EDGAR filing pipeline (5 phases A–E)
subsystems.purpose: Filing section extraction → relationship extraction → counterparty resolution → supply-chain graph → fan-out orchestration
subsystems.curation_dismiss: dismiss = curator_private tombstone in counterparty_aliases (null canonical fields, migration 77bcb5d1bfbd); resolver + unresolved queue skip tombstoned norms; DELETE undoes (PR #44). /relationships/dismissed must stay declared above /relationships/{param} routes.

subsystems.name: Workspace loop (5 steps)
subsystems.purpose: Post-thesis refresh: update_refresh → research → validation → challenge → differentiation (execution order pinned by STEP_NAMES in services/workspace_steps.py); produces updated verdict + model deltas
subsystems.model_state_touchpoint: update_refresh promotes published forecast periods from ai_baseline → historical and warns when previously-edited override cells are evicted (removed_cells payload)
subsystems.preflight: missing ticker_models → non-blocking no_ticker_model warning; step_update_refresh skips model work (model_skipped=true on UpdateRefreshOutput) but still surfaces new filings (PR #44). Unsaved model draft / in-flight run still block.
subsystems.sse: fan-out + per-run replay buffer — late subscribers get a full replay (PR #42)

subsystems.name: Status board + unified calendar + questions + read-throughs + earnings + Today briefing
subsystems.purpose: Post-thesis fleet-management surface aggregating over completed research runs
subsystems.perf_notes: archived_at carried on StatusBoardEntry rows; partial index eb21c3df2ad5 (latest-run composite, archived_at IS NULL); /status refetch is visibility-debounced (PR #43)

subsystems.name: Editable 5-year financial model + reverse DCF
subsystems.purpose: Per-ticker model AI-seeded from research run with version history, cell-level overrides, and reverse-DCF engine (implied drivers, IRR, 21x21 sensitivity grids)
subsystems.cell_path_value_object: typed CellPath union (DriverPath | StatementCellPath | AssumptionPath) — backend backend/app/models/cell_path.py, frontend frontend/lib/cellPath.ts. AssumptionPath restricted to ModelCell-shaped keys; categorical assumptions intentionally not editable through PUT /draft.
subsystems.live_quote_cache: GET /reverse-dcf live FMP quote goes through a 30s in-process TTL cache (_LIVE_PRICE_TTL_SECONDS in models_api.py; 0.0 never cached) (PR #43)

subsystems.name: Verdict outcome tracker (alpha feedback loop)
subsystems.purpose: Record entry prices at verdict emission, then snapshot ticker / SPY / sector ETF / theme basket returns at 1d/1w/1m/3m/6m horizons
subsystems.incomplete_markers: snapshot serializers add "incomplete": true when expected fields / step_outputs are absent — existing persisted snapshots unchanged (PR #46)
subsystems.summary_populated_offsets: GET /api/outcomes/summary returns populated_offsets; /performance defaults data-first — picks the most-populated offset (6m→1d priority) when no URL param (PR #44)

subsystems.name: Transcript delta analysis
subsystems.purpose: Haiku-driven QoQ language deltas across earnings transcripts, scored along several axes

subsystems.name: S-1 prospectus pipeline (4 steps)
subsystems.purpose: Per-S-1/S-1/A: ingest → relationships → categories (7 IPO-tuned) → thesis. Reuses the existing filings/relationships infrastructure under a synthetic_ticker identifier so pre-IPO issuers (e.g. SpaceX) flow through the same plumbing as public companies.
subsystems.synthetic_ticker: Identifier written into filings.ticker / relationships.ticker for pre-IPO issuers. proposed_ticker if disclosed, else uppercase-alphanumeric slug of issuer_name truncated to 16 chars. Lets the existing 5-phase EDGAR pipeline work unchanged.
subsystems.section_routing: S-1 section_keys: s1_business, s1_risk_factors, s1_mda, s1_use_of_proceeds, s1_capitalization, s1_dilution, s1_principal_stockholders, s1_underwriting. Defined in edgar_html.py::_SECTION_DEFS_S1 (PR #31).
subsystems.sse: fan-out + per-run replay buffer, same pattern as WorkspaceService (PR #46)

subsystems.name: Company workspace
subsystems.purpose: Fiscal.ai-inspired per-ticker shell: overview / financials / model / peers / research / theses / transcripts / filings tabs. Merged in PR #32.

subsystems.name: Material events + insider signal
subsystems.purpose: Daily 06:30 UTC universe scan (theme seeds ∪ active theses): 8-Ks item-code-prefiltered then Haiku-classified into material_events; Form 4 via FMP into insider_transactions → pure 90-day aggregate → signals row (signal_type=insider) → bounded discovery-score modifier (+5 cluster / +2 net buying / −3 pronounced selling, clamp [0,100]). 8-K failures fault-isolated from insider ingest. Merged in PR #38.

subsystems.name: Peer comparison
subsystems.purpose: Single shared 16-metric comp builder (services/peer_comp.py, 4 FMP endpoints — valuation multiples live on ratios-ttm, NOT key-metrics-ttm) over curated peer_sets (auto-seeded from resolved competitor_landscape ∪ FMPClient.get_stock_peers, cap 8; manual edits cap 12). Three consumers: /api/peers/{ticker}/comp, /api/peers/compare, workspace step 5 (differentiation via peers_for_ticker). Merged in PR #34.
frontend_routes: /compare (URL is the state; no nav link by design)

subsystems.name: Trade journal
subsystems.purpose: Manual entry/exit trade log linked to verdict_outcomes (nullable FK, SET NULL). FMP adjusted-close auto-fill (on-or-before, 7-day lookback) with sticky manual prices; pure decision-vs-paper comparison at the outcome snapshot nearest the holding period (midpoint thresholds 4/18/60/136 days). Merged in PR #40.

services.purpose: Trade-journal CRUD + FMP adjusted-close auto-fill — commit-free, callers own the session

services.purpose: Pure math: direction-aware fractional returns (short = −long), SPY excess over holding period, decision-vs-paper at nearest snapshot offset (labeled, never interpolated)

services.name: material_events_scheduler

services.name: metric_guards

services.name: model_balancing
services.purpose: Pure recompute pipeline: drivers → IS → CF → BS; plug imbalance into retained_earnings; raises ModelBalanceError on tolerance overflow

services.name: model_baseline
services.purpose: Orchestrate AI baseline seeding into ModelState (load research_run + risk-free rate → Sonnet baseline-drivers node → seed historical + forecast drivers → recompute)

services.name: model_diff

services.name: outcome_tracker
services.purpose: Verdict outcome tracking — resolve entry prices, create outcomes, refresh return snapshots at 1d/1w/1m/3m/6m

services.name: peer_comp

services.name: peer_sets
services.purpose: Curated peer sets — auto-seed (cap 8) / manual (cap 12); commit-free, callers own the session; peers_for_ticker is the shared curated-first read path

services.name: pipeline
services.purpose: PipelineService — run lifecycle, state persistence, SSE plumbing (in-memory dict[run_id, asyncio.Queue]), holds _next_phase routing (parallel to graph/pipeline.py edges)

services.name: prospectus_categories
services.purpose: Runs Sonnet over each of 7 IPO-tuned categories defined in graph/prospectus_prompts.py::PROSPECTUS_CATEGORIES. Slot-routes filing excerpts (per CATEGORY_SECTION_ROUTING), counterparty context, and FRED macro into PROSPECTUS_USER. Section budget: 8000 chars/section.

services.name: prospectus_financials

services.name: prospectus_ingest
services.purpose: Resolve, fetch, and extract sections from an S-1 / S-1/A. Persists Filing + FilingSection rows under a synthetic_ticker so the existing downstream pipeline (relationships, resolution, fan-out) works unchanged. parse_source_input handles both URL and bare accession inputs.

services.name: prospectus_service

services.name: prospectus_thesis
services.purpose: Synthesizes the final ProspectusThesisOutput: thesis statement, key risks (severity + category source), IPO verdict (participate / watch_post_lockup / pass), and a post-IPO research plan.

services.name: quant_fingerprint

phases.name: quick_screen
phases.purpose: Structural pre-filter — market cap, sector, industry, volatility

phases.name: deep_dive

phases.purpose: Retry logic for priority-1 auto-answerable questions from deep-dive

phases.name: thesis_construction
phases.purpose: Thesis with pillars, bull/bear, catalysts, kill criteria. Receives quick-screen context + deep-dive summary as 'established findings' with no-restate instruction (prompt-dedup).

phases.name: risk_stress_test
phases.purpose: Scenario stress testing. Optional loop back to deep_dive if loop_count ≤ 2 and loop_required=true.

phases.name: position_monitor
phases.purpose: Phase 6 — manually triggered via POST /api/runs/{id}/advance with action='approve' on completed run. Kill-criterion tracking + outcome creation.

invariants.rule: Always launch uvicorn from PROJECT ROOT — never from backend/
invariants.why: Backend uses absolute imports rooted at project root (backend.app.*). Running uvicorn from backend/ breaks every import.
invariants.verify: Tests + migrations also need PYTHONPATH or pip install -e .

invariants.rule: .env lives at PROJECT ROOT and stays there
invariants.why: backend/app/config.py hard-codes env_file='../../.env' (relative to backend/app/). Moving it breaks Settings load.
invariants.verify: Required keys: FMP_API_KEY, X_BEARER_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL (asyncpg), DATABASE_URL_SYNC, SEC_USER_AGENT

invariants.rule: Every model/filing/earnings endpoint normalizes ticker = ticker.upper() at entry
invariants.why: ticker_models, ticker_model_drafts, research_runs, earnings_prints all store tickers upper-case. Lookups against existing rows break otherwise + duplicate-identity drafts possible.

invariants.rule: async_session() does NOT autocommit — explicit await db.commit() required
invariants.why: expire_on_commit=False but no autocommit. Forgetting this means nothing persists silently.
applies_to: any service that opens its own session

invariants.rule: Use app.state.fmp via request.app.state.fmp — do NOT instantiate FMPClient() in endpoints
invariants.why: Singleton from lifespan owns the rate limiter and shared session. Wraps Request to access it.
invariants.example: models_api.get_reverse_dcf uses request.app.state.fmp for the live price default

invariants.rule: Pipeline phase routing has ONE source of truth: PHASE_SEQUENCE / next_phase() in graph/pipeline.py. services/pipeline.py::_next_phase delegates there.
invariants.why: PR #42 collapsed the former dual-truth. backend/tests/test_phase_routing.py pins the contract; add phases by editing PHASE_SEQUENCE (and graph edges derive from it).

invariants.rule: Python pipeline._emit calls and the TypeScript SSEEvent discriminated union MUST stay in sync
invariants.why: SSEEvent in frontend/lib/api/pipeline.ts is a discriminated union. New event types added on the Python side won’t be typed on the frontend.

invariants.rule: Three Citation shapes exist — keep them aligned

shapes.Citation: in-memory dataclass in backend/app/models/citation.py — used for return-tuples from data clients (data, Citation)
shapes.CitationRecord: ORM persisted form in same file (citations table)
shapes.StateCitation: JSON-serializable form in backend/app/graph/state.py with ISO-string timestamp — what lives inside ResearchState.state JSONB

invariants.note: Adding a new data source requires preserving the (data, Citation) tuple convention. Migration 2db2e8812418 added cell_path so research citations can deep-link to model cells; existing JSONB rows round-trip as dicts.

invariants.rule: Use frontend/components/deep-dive/scoreKeys.ts::normalizeScoreKeys at every backend → frontend boundary
invariants.why: Report API returns display-name keys ('Macro & Regime') while ScoreBar / radar / chip components expect snake_case. Skipping it silently produces all-em-dash ScoreBar.

invariants.rule: Use scoreColors.ts (4-tier at 40/55/70 thresholds) for score-tier coloring; use heatmapColors.ts (diverging, value-relative) for sensitivity grids
invariants.why: Local if/else palettes at 40/50/70 cluster everything 40-60 into a single amber band. Diverging heatmap palette is for grid coloring, not score tiers — don't swap them.

invariants.rule: Next.js 16 has breaking changes. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before editing routing, middleware, route handlers, or Server Component APIs.
invariants.why: Training-data conventions for middleware.ts, route-handler shapes, and caching primitives don't match Next 16.

invariants.rule: FanoutStatus is in-memory only — does NOT survive backend restart
invariants.why: Acceptable for personal tool; warning is in CLAUDE.md. If you persist it later, update FanoutService accordingly.

invariants.rule: force=True on fan-out endpoints only affects the EXTRACT stage; resolve already skips rows with resolved_to_cik IS NOT NULL
invariants.why: Don't add force-resolve logic — counterparty resolution is intentionally one-way.

invariants.rule: cell_path wire format is owned by typed CellPath union on both sides
invariants.shapes: DriverPath | StatementCellPath | AssumptionPath. AssumptionPath only accepts ModelCell-shaped keys (discount_rate, terminal_multiple, perpetuity_growth, tax_rate). Categorical assumptions (terminal_method, plug_priority) need a separate typed surface — intentionally deferred.

invariants.rule: Customer concentration data does NOT live in xbrl_facts — it comes from Phase B relationship extraction with Relationship.unnamed=true
invariants.why: ConcentrationRiskPercentage1 is always disclosed dimensionally and the SEC companyfacts API only exposes un-dimensioned parent facts. The xbrl_facts table covers RPO, debt maturity, credit only.

invariants.rule: Pin NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL to http://127.0.0.1:8000 (not localhost) if Docker is running
invariants.why: Docker dashboard-api-1 can steal IPv6 localhost:8000 from uvicorn — see memory project_localhost_ipv6_docker_collision

invariants.rule: Tag new sticky UI (nav, action buttons, modals) with data-print-hide='true'
invariants.why: @media print in app/globals.css hides any element with that attribute and forces opaque surfaces, so the PDF doesn't show chrome.

invariants.rule: DataRichSection and MixedSection render AICompanionPanel twice — once with section='summary' inside the chart grid, once with section='analysis' as a full-width block below
invariants.why: Prevents the analysis paragraph from making the right column 2x taller than the charts and leaving empty whitespace on the left. QualitativeCard renders it without a section prop (single-column).

invariants.rule: phases.deep_dive in the report API is { categories: Record<str, CategoryOutput>, curated_financials: CuratedFinancials | null } — NOT a flat record
Tests run under Python's stdlib unittest — python -m unittest backend.tests.<module> from project root with venv active
invariants.why: No pytest, no coverage harness. Don't introduce pytest unless intentionally migrating.

invariants.rule: Prospectus (S-1) issuers are written into filings.ticker / relationships.ticker under a `synthetic_ticker` — proposed_ticker if disclosed, else uppercase-alphanumeric slug of issuer_name truncated to 16 chars
invariants.why: Lets the entire existing 5-phase EDGAR pipeline (section extraction, relationship extraction, counterparty resolution, supply-chain graph) work unchanged on pre-IPO issuers. The derived value lives in ProspectusReport.synthetic_ticker (@property in backend/app/models/prospectus_report.py). Don't ticker.upper() it again at endpoint boundary — the property already normalizes.

invariants.rule: Prospectus CategoryCard score color thresholds are IPO-specific — do NOT replace with scoreColors.ts (equity 40/55/70 tiers)
invariants.why: IPO scoring uses a different rubric (0-30 disqualifying, 31-55 uncertain, 56-75 typical, 76-100 standout) defined in graph/prospectus_prompts.py PROSPECTUS_SYSTEM. Equity tiers would map IPO scores wrong.

invariants.rule: Two literal routes must stay declared BEFORE their sibling path-param routes: /api/peers/compare before /api/peers/{ticker}, and /api/catalysts/calendar before /api/catalysts/{catalyst_id}
invariants.why: 'compare' parses as a valid ticker and 'calendar' as a path param — declared later, the literal routes become unreachable.

invariants.rule: services/journal.py and services/peer_sets.py write WITHOUT committing — callers own the session
invariants.why: API routes commit; the workspace differentiation step composes peers_for_ticker inside its own transaction. Adding a commit inside these services would break callers that batch multiple writes.
invariants.verify: grep for db.commit() in those files — should be absent.

invariants.rule: Workspace loop execution order is update_refresh → research → validation → challenge → differentiation — pinned by STEP_NAMES in services/workspace_steps.py
invariants.why: validation re-runs the reverse-DCF against the post-Step-1 model version, and challenge consumes Step 1's model deltas. Docs that list challenge before validation are wrong.

invariants.rule: All three SSE services fan out to multiple subscriber queues per run. PipelineService has NO replay; WorkspaceService and ProspectusService keep a per-run replay buffer — late subscribers get a full replay on event_stream() entry.
invariants.why: PR #42 (pipeline + workspace fan-out, workspace replay) and PR #46 (prospectus replay). Don’t assume pipeline late-joiners see early events.

invariants.rule: Background tasks (asyncio.create_task phase/step execution) open their own async_session() — request-scoped sessions never cross into background work.
invariants.why: PR #42 (A2). A request session dies with the response; a task holding it would operate on a closed session.

invariants.rule: Workspace preflight: a missing ticker_models row is a non-blocking warning (PreflightStatus.warnings=["no_ticker_model"]), not a blocker. step_update_refresh then skips all model work (model_skipped=true, version_before=0) and still surfaces new EDGAR filings. An unsaved model draft or in-flight run still blocks.
invariants.why: PR #44 (B3 phase 1 earnings-day unblock). A workspace exists with just a completed research_run.

invariants.rule: Margin metrics pass through services/metric_guards.py::guard_margin (shared by company_snapshot + peer_comp): impossible grossProfitMarginTTM > 1.0 is nulled, other margins outside [-5, 1.5] log-only. Backend emits fraction-form margins (0.69 = 69%); frontend multiplies by 100 exactly once.
invariants.why: PR #44. Pinned by backend/tests/test_metric_scaling.py. Tiny-base growth beyond ±1000% renders "n/m" (NM_GROWTH_THRESHOLD, mirrored in frontend/components/company/formatStat.ts).

next_agent_hints: Start by reading CLAUDE.md (lives at project root) — it has prose context this JSON references but doesn't restate.
TODO.md tracks live in-progress work and a 'Done (recent)' log — check before starting anything substantive.
Active specs live in docs/superpowers/specs/ (gitignored, local-only). Old plans recoverable from git history (git log --all --diff-filter=D -- docs/).

When adding a new HTTP endpoint: (1) add to backend/app/api/<router>.py, (2) ensure main.py mounts the router with the right prefix, (3) add a matching function/namespace in the right frontend/lib/api/<domain>.ts module (type the response too; the barrel re-exports it).

When adding a new ORM column: write an alembic migration via `cd backend && alembic revision --autogenerate -m '...'`, review the generated file (autogen misses CHECK constraints, partial indexes, and CASCADE changes), then run `alembic upgrade head`.

When adding a new pipeline phase: edit PHASE_SEQUENCE / next_phase() in graph/pipeline.py (single source of routing truth — services/pipeline.py::_next_phase delegates; test_phase_routing.py pins it). Add the node function to graph/nodes.py. Update SSEEvent in frontend/lib/api/pipeline.ts for any new event types.

When adding a new deep-dive category: update categories.ts (single source of truth) and the section registry in sections.ts. Use scoreColors.ts and normalizeScoreKeys; do not introduce local palettes.

When adding a new workspace step: define the output schema in models/workspace_schemas.py, implement in services/workspace_steps.py, wire it into WorkspaceService.advance_step, and add a StepCard under components/workspace/StepCards/.
When touching the model: every cell_path edit goes through put_draft → cell_path.py validator → recompute() → ticker_model_drafts. Don't bypass recompute — formula cells depend on it.
When adding a new data source: keep the (data, Citation) tuple convention. Persist as CitationRecord; round-trip through state as StateCitation.

Pre-existing utility hooks you should reuse before writing your own: usePersistedCollapse (localStorage-backed collapse), normalizeScoreKeys (display→snake_case score keys), fmtMarketCap/fmtPct/fmtScore (lib/api/pipeline.ts formatters), CellPath value object (typed cell paths).

Prospectus pipeline (PR #31): a parallel 4-step orchestrator for S-1 / S-1/A filings. Reuses the entire filings/relationships/fan-out plumbing under a synthetic_ticker so the new code surface is small. Adding a new prospectus step: define the schema in models/prospectus_schemas.py, implement in services/prospectus_*.py, wire into ProspectusService._run_pipeline, then add a StepCard under components/prospectus/StepCards/. Prompts + section routing live in graph/prospectus_prompts.py (PROSPECTUS_CATEGORIES, CATEGORY_SECTION_ROUTING). S-1 section regexes live in edgar_html.py::_SECTION_DEFS_S1.
